en: \bMustard: I'm just itching for a battle!
\bMustard: I'm pleased as cheese to join you!
\bMustard: Catch you around!
\bPeony: Let's have ourselves a smashin' adventure!
\bPeony: Off we go, chief!
\bPeony: Come on, mate! Don't leave me hangin'!
\bRaihan: We'll send everyone in the stadium flying!
\bRaihan: I'll show you what it's like to have a future champ by your side!
\bRaihan: Cheers!
\bLeon: You've got nothing to worry about while I'm around.
\bLeon: We're going to get the crowd roaring!
\bLeon: 'Til next time!
\bHop: Let's show everyone the greatest battle ever – and set the world on fire!
\bHop: Let's give 'em a taste of our true power!
\bHop: Catch you later!
\bBede: Let's show them a world they haven't seen before.
\bBede: Follow my example.
\bBede: I suppose I must excuse myself.
\rMarnie: My cheers will really get us goin'!
\rMarnie: Sure, I can lend you a hand.
\rMarnie: See you 'round.
\bVictor: I'll show you what I can do!
\bVictor: Let me join you!
\bVictor: Later!
\rGloria: Hullo! You're bringing me along, right?
\rGloria: Of course you are.
\rGloria: Aww, see ya!
\rMagnolia: You look like you could you an expert on Dynamax by your side.
\rMagnolia: I'll give you all the support I can give.
\rMagnolia: Very well.
\rSonia: Y-you want me on the team?
\rSonia: All right! I'll count on you if we're in a pinch!
\rSonia: Alright. Byeee!
\rOleana: There is beauty, even in trash.
\rOleana: Ohoho, interesting! Allow me to join you.
\rOleana: I must excuse myself.
\bRose: I'm curious to see your potential.
\bRose: Excellent. I'll give it my all as well!
\bRose: Goodbye for now!
\rMai: Want me to lend you a hand?
\rMai: Time to investigate!
\rMai: Later!
\bLian: I suppose I shouldn't turn you away before you say anything.
\bLian: Help? I suppose you recognise my skill.
\bLian: And it seems we've settled things here.
\rArezu: I'm great at both Pokémon battles and haircuts!
\rArezu: Count me in! I'd like to learn even more with you!
\rArezu: Let me know if you'd like a haircut later!
\rCalaba: I suppose you've come to bother me to ask for my help.
\rCalaba: I suppose I could lend a whelp like you my guidance.
\rCalaba: Ho, interesting!
\bIscan: So, um... you want m-my help?
\bIscan: Well then... i-if you insist.
\bIscan: Um... okay.
\rPalina: I would be happy to see your potential in action, by your side.
\rPalina: Certainly.
\rPalina: You'd best be off then.
\bMelli: So, you want to team up with the great Melli?
\bMelli: Fine! Be glad and rejoice!
\bMelli: Oh, for shame! What utter calamity...
\bIngo: Let's conduct our victory together.
\bIngo: Onward we roll!
\bIngo: Until next time.
\rSabi: You'll always be okay if you've got a trusty partner, like me!
\rSabi: It's nice having someone new to play with! Let's go!
\rSabi: Aww, you don't want to play with Sabi?
\bGaeric: My musculature is as hard and unyielding as ice!
\bGaeric: This one's alright. Let's get on with it now!
\bGaeric: Till next we meet!
\rCoin: I'm bored. Wish there were someone to rob...
\rCoin: Oh? I'll be your good-luck piece, then!
\rCoin: Guess I lose the coin toss sometimes...
\rCharm: You don't appear to be frightened to see me.
\rCharm: Very well, I'll be your lucky Charm!
\rCharm: I suppose Charms don't work all the time...
\rClover: You saw me out here and didn't even think to turn and run?
\rClover: Hehe, your luck won't run out with me by your side!
\rClover: I guess my luck ran out...
\bBeni: Oh, you see potential in my ninja techniques?
\bBeni: Your dream of victory is mine, too.
